notes: v508 — 🪜 Pullback now demands its evidence. The rule has always asked for shares in a confirmed uptrend that have dipped back to their 20-day line with a cooled RSI — but it had a forgiving branch: if a share didn't have 200 days of history to confirm the long uptrend, it was waved through on the 50-day trend alone. That branch is why your device (holding only what it downloads) found 42 pullbacks where the server (holding the full year) found 23 — the server wasn't stricter by design, it was stricter because it KNEW more. From today the rule is strict everywhere: no 200-day view means the uptrend cannot be verified, and an uptrend that cannot be verified cannot fire. This is the same principle the evidence panel has always run on — 'too early to tell' is not a verdict. You will see fewer 🪜 results, especially on newly listed or lightly downloaded shares, and that is the rule being honest rather than the app being broken. The 🔬 server check's readout now tells you how many shares this device cannot judge for lack of a 200-day view. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
